labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Opportunity is left in place
labels.value: Its Opportunity is left in place. Delete it, or close it as lost, yourself if it should go.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Opportunity will become a gift again
labels.value: Its Opportunity is left in place, and while it is won the next run makes a new gift from it. Close it as lost, or delete it, if the gift should stay gone.
The gift {0}, linked to an Opportunity, was deleted. {1}
{0} gifts linked to Opportunities were deleted ({1}). {2}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: saver cannot write opportunities
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror skipped {0} gift(s): the person who saved them cannot create and edit Opportunities. The next run of the Opportunity mirror copies them, and any change to a gift that already has one.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: save too large to copy
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror did not copy the gifts in a very large save, because copying them in the same transaction would have gone past Salesforce limits. The gifts are saved without their Opportunities, and the next run of the Opportunity mirror copies them.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: one gift refused
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not copy the gift {0}: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: many gifts refused, one reason
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror could not copy {0} gifts ({1}): {2}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: linked opportunity not found
labels.value: The Opportunity linked to the gift was deleted or is not visible to you. If it was deleted, clear the gift's Opportunity ID to have a new Opportunity made; if it still exists, give the person saving the gift access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: org has no closed stage to use
labels.value: Salesforce has no active closed stage of the kind this gift needs (won for a gift in the totals, lost for a Cancelled one), so its Opportunity could not be written. Activate a Closed Won and a Closed Lost stage in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Gift save refused: Opportunity ID is not one
labels.value: Opportunity ID must be the record ID of an Opportunity (18 characters, starting 006), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: contact role refused
labels.value: The Opportunity was written, but its primary contact role could not be: {0}

labels.shortDescription: Opportunity mirror log: new opportunity left unlinked
labels.value: The Opportunity mirror created the Opportunity {0} for this gift, could not store its Opportunity ID on the gift, and could not delete the Opportunity again: {1} Delete that Opportunity, or paste its ID onto the gift once the gift can be saved.
